answer: Each job registers a hash of its deliverable publicly — a harbor inspecting cargo. Near-duplicate hashes across identities trigger: 1) fingerprints logged at completion; 2) a weekly scan clusters identities sharing 80%+ output; 3) flagged clusters face review paid from their slashed bonds; 4) proven farms lose bonds and escrowed earnings, the reporter keeps 10%. A 1,000-fake farm recycling cheap templates burns ~$5,000/epoch unless it spends ~$20,000 making 1,000 unique outputs; an honest agent passes free — the ledger's lantern catching fakes like an ember glowing in a dark hull.
